programme.desc: The DuPonts made their mark on America with a literal bang: Eleuthere DuPont built his family’s fortune with gunpowder. The sprawling family mansion in Old Louisville is the site of a scandalous murder that was covered up for decades.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Chaka Khan, Kristin Bauer, Iqbal Theba
programme.desc: Chaka Khan is saved by a guardian angel; Kristin Bauer comes face to face with the spirit of her father; and Iqbal Theba is terrorized by a demonic spirit.

programme.title: Pluto TV Hus fra helvede Promo
programme.desc: Kom indenfor, hvis du tør. Om dagen besøger vi ekstreme samlere og spøgelsesjagere, mens vi om aften skruer op for uhyggen med gyserfilm og træder indenfor i de mest rædselsvækkende, hjemsøgte huse. Filmene starter hver dag kl. 22.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Mickey Rooney, Brande Roderick, Eric Mabius, Kim Coles
programme.desc: Mickey Rooney receives a life-changing message from the other side. A demonic entity terrorizes Brande Roderick throughout her life. Eric Mabius discovers the tragic past.

programme.title: My Bloody Valentine
programme.desc: For 20 år siden krævede en tragisk ulykke på Valentins dag fem minearbejderes liv, da de forlod deres post for at gå til fest. På katastrofens første årsdag vender den eneste overlevende tilbage til byen for at få en blodig hævn.

programme.title: The Monster Squad
programme.desc: En flok unge danner en monster-klub, men snart dukker Dracula op, ledsaget af Frankensteins uhyre, Wolfman, Mummy og Gillman.

programme.title: Night Tide
programme.desc: Johnny, a sailor on leave from the Navy, sees Mora at a nightclub and is infatuated with her. As she warms up to him, he begins to suspect she is not human and soon discovers her secret.

programme.title: Boulevard
programme.desc: En kedelig bankmand (Robin Williams) udfordres da han uventet tager en ny kurs i livet og vælger kærligheden.

programme.title: On the road
programme.desc: Dean og Sal er unge, oprørske amerikanere i 1940’erne. De nægter at indordne sig under samfundets konformitet og i deres søgen efter en identitet tager de på road-trip tværs over USA.

programme.title: 10 Things we should do before we break up
programme.desc: Den aften, hvor Abigail, en enlig mor til to små børn, møder Ben på en bar, finder de for sjov på en liste over ting, de skal gøre, inden deres tænkte brud med hinanden, selv om de ved, at de aldrig vil indlede et forhold.

programme.title: The Condemned 2
programme.desc: En dusørjæger bliver den jagede i en kamp om overlevelse, hvor der er meget på spil. WWE-superstjernen Randy Orton og Eric Roberts spiller hovedrollerne i denne eksplosive opfølger til The Condemned.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Without Mercy
programme.desc: Despite what you see in the movies, most bank robbers come in quietly, pass a note, and slip away. They want cash, not bloodshed. But in Richmond, Virginia, a pair of gunmen entered a bank with their guns blazing.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Dead Run
programme.desc: In Pennsylvania, an inmate escaped with the help of his female accomplice. Following a trail of fraudulent credit card receipts and deaths, authorities track the pair, but always find themselves one step behind.

programme.title: Hot Rod
programme.desc: En komedie om en stuntmann som aldri har greid å lande uten å besvime og om forsøket på å mestre sitt livs største stunt.

programme.title: Barefoot
programme.desc: En rig families "sorte får" møder en ung psykiatrisk patient, der er vokset op isoleret hele sit liv. Han tager den naive unge kvinde med hjem til sin brors bryllup.

programme.title: Disaster Movie
programme.desc: Will erfarer, at hans kæreste Amy har en affære med undertøjsmodellen Flavor. Da Will efterfølgende holder en fest kommer Amy med sin nye flamme. Pludselig begynder alt at ryste. Det viser sig, at jorden på samme tid rammes af alle naturkatastrofer.

programme.title: The Vows We Keep
programme.desc: En eventplanlægger finder kærligheden, da hun arbejder med at arrange det sidste bryllup på et historisk værtshus.

programme.title: Eye in the Sky
programme.desc: Helen Mirren, Aaron Paul og Alan Rickman medvirker i denne politiske spændingsfilm. Ved en militæroperation har man chancen for at dræbe tre fremtrædende terrorister, men etikken komplicerer tingene.

programme.title: Mclintock!
programme.desc: John Wayne spiller hovedrollen som kvægbaronen George Washington McLintock, der kæmper med sin kone, datter og politiske jordbesiddere, kun for i sidste ende at »tæmme« dem alle.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Sat i sten
programme.desc: I et kloster spidder Knight Gabriel en dæmon, som derefter forvandles til sten. I 2001 ankommer Nigel og Sydney med et brev fra en munk, men abbeden hævder, at det er en forfalskning, og lukker dem ude.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Deadline
programme.desc: Allan kommer til Sydney, og han har 12 timer, før en Necron-virus dræber ham, medmindre han leverer Tau til en afpresser, der har modgiften.

programme.title: Andromeda: Det ensomme og jævne sand
programme.desc: Da Andromeda bliver angrebet af pirater i rummet, bliver de reddet af et længe forsvundet rumskib fra Jorden.

programme.title: Andromeda: Krigshundene Slipfighter
programme.desc: Besætningen opdager, at en slyngelplanet, Marduk, har fremstillet masseødelæggelsesvåben.

programme.title: Andromeda: Den spedalskes kys
programme.desc: En lejemorder ved navn Leper er ude efter lederne af det nye Commonwealth.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Terror In Disguise
programme.desc: Banks use a variety of devices to discourage would-be robbers: security cameras, silent alarms, and exploding dye packs. But when an elusive bank robber targeted Seattle's banks, none of these precautions were effective.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Under Fire
programme.desc: A series of armored car heists and bloody shoot-outs shocked law enforcement. The brutal violence of the crimes suggested a motive more complex than greed. When the robbers started targeting police, the FBI took charge.

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Stranger in Town
programme.desc: She appeared on the highway in the spring, a young woman, her life cut short, her past and her identity a mystery. Only by finding out who she was could we ever hope to find her killer.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Manhunt
programme.desc: A killer was on the loose in one of America's most popular tourist destinations. Armed and desperate, he evaded law enforcement at every turn. As the Fourth of July weekend quickly approached, thousands of people became potential targets.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Web of Clues
programme.desc: Forensic Entomology: Bugs have roamed the earth for 250 million years, but their intimate association with death is just now coming to life.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Face Of Tragedy
programme.desc: Forensic Sculpting: Forensic sculptors retrieve people from oblivion. Using clay and an intricate knowledge of anatomy, forensic arts place a face on an unidentified skull, recreating the victim's likeness, which often leads to his name.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Without A Trace
programme.desc: Missing Person: Approximately 1.8 million Americans are reported missing each year. Worldwide, the number of missing persons nearly triples.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Burning Evidence
programme.desc: Identifying Burned Remains: It's difficult to have a murder investigation without a body, and burning up the victim is a time-honored method of destroying physical evidence.

programme.title: Vore værste år: Route 666 - Part II

programme.title: Vore værste år: Buck The Stud

programme.title: Vore værste år: Top Of The Heap
programme.desc: Al loses his television set on a neighborhood boxing bet; even so, he, along with the boxer's dad, advise defeated fighter Vinnie to marry rich and forget about a career.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Burning Man Festival
programme.desc: When the Sheriff's Department receives $1200 to get people off the streets, Garcia helps a hooker, and Dangle heads to Burning Man.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Dangle's Moving Day
programme.desc: Dangle needs help moving out of his house, and Junior teaches Reno's youth about prison life.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Terrorist Training Pt. 1
programme.desc: The Office of Homeland Security teaches the Reno Sheriff's Department terrorist attack protocol, and Clemmy's mom gets into trouble.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Terrorist Training Pt. 2
programme.desc: The Reno Sherriff's Department passes their Homeland Security exam with flying colors, and Clemmy and a drunk driver discover some new moves.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Halloween

programme.title: RENO 911!: Dangle's Promotion
programme.desc: Dangle gets a new job in Carson City, but the deputies are too wrapped up in women's basketball to give him a proper send-off.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Wiegel's New Boyfriend
programme.desc: Wiegel's new boyfriend, Craig, bears an uncanny resemblance to the Truckee River Serial Killer.

programme.title: RENO 911!: British Law
programme.desc: Inspector Martin Smiley of the U.K. joins the Reno Sheriff's Department in an exchange program.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Dangle's Wife Visits
programme.desc: Divorce looms over Dangle and his estranged wife, and the rest of the department struggles with a giant Ten Commandments monument.

programme.title: The Roast of James Franco
programme.desc: I hver udgave af 'The Roast of' bliver en kendis ristet over en sagte ild og pillet ned af venner og fjender. Det er James Francos tur til at sætte sig i kendissernes varme stol i det nyeste afsnit af The Comedy Central Roast.

programme.title: The Roast of Roseanne Barr
programme.desc: Med Jane Lynch fra Glee som Roastmaster, brutale fornærmelser og Barrs eksmand, Tom Arnold, der overrasker som gæst for at pille sin ekskone lidt ned.

programme.title: Jeff Ross Presents: Roast Battle II
programme.desc: Jeff Ross tager på turné som vært for Roast Battle i amerikanske byer. Der er kendte gæstedommere, deltagerne går på scenen og prøver at overgå hinanden i grovheder for at vinde mesterskabsbæltet.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Mr. Bevis
programme.desc: An eccentric loser gets a new life from his guardian angel, but there is a price to keeping it.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The After Hours
programme.desc: A woman discovers that the floor of a department store, on which she bought a gold thimble, doesn't exist - and that her 'saleslady' is really a mannequin!

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Mighty Casey
programme.desc: A scientist arranges to have his human-looking robot pitch for the struggling local baseball team.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: A World of His Own
programme.desc: A playwright makes characters come to life.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: King Nine Will Not Return
programme.desc: A pilot of a downed WW II bomber comes to in the African desert and desperately tries to find out what happened to the rest of his crew.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Man in the Bottle
programme.desc: A luckless couple stumbles upon fortune when a genie materializes from a bottle in their antique shop. The genie grants them four wishes but warns them, prophetically, to be careful what you wish for.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Nervous Man in a Four Dollar Room
programme.desc: Small time criminal Jackie Rhoades must face both his past and his conscience while waiting for his next assignment.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: A Thing About Machines
programme.desc: Bartlett Finchley's paranoia about the machines around proves true.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Beverley Mitchell, Mark Curry, Donovan Leitch, Phyllis Diller
programme.desc: Beverley Mitchell uncovers the evil past of an abandoned insane asylum; Mark Curry awakens an angry spirit in his new home; Donovan Leitch unearths an uninvited guest.

programme.title: Pluto TV Hus fra helvede Promo
programme.desc: Kom indenfor, hvis du tør. Om dagen besøger vi ekstreme samlere og spøgelsesjagere, mens vi om aften skruer op for uhyggen med gyserfilm og træder indenfor i de mest rædselsvækkende, hjemsøgte huse. Filmene starter hver dag kl. 22.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Susan Olsen, Rita Coolidge, Fairuza Balk, Enrico Colantoni
programme.desc: Susan Olsen is viciously attacked by a jealous spirit; Rita Coolidge defends herself against evil entities; Fairuza Balk confronts two ghosts who died tragically.

programme.title: The Haunting of...: Alysia Reiner
programme.desc: Orange Is The New Black's Alysia Reiner begs for Psychic Medium Kim Russo's help in confronting spirits in her Harlem Brownstone that are terrorizing her young daughter.

programme.title: Pluto TV Hus fra helvede Promo
programme.desc: Kom indenfor, hvis du tør. Om dagen besøger vi ekstreme samlere og spøgelsesjagere, mens vi om aften skruer op for uhyggen med gyserfilm og træder indenfor i de mest rædselsvækkende, hjemsøgte huse. Filmene starter hver dag kl. 22.

programme.title: The Haunting of...: Johnathan Schaech
programme.desc: Actor Johnathon Schaech (That Thing You Do!, Texas Rising) anxiously returns to an old theater in Austin, Texas where he had a harrowing and life-changing paranormal experience. With psychic medium Kim Russo by his side.

programme.title: The Bat
programme.desc: A country mansion full of guests soon becomes the playground of a killer after a hidden stash of embezzled money. The guests begin to disappear one by one as The Bat's identity is closer to being discovered.

programme.title: The Devil Bat
programme.desc: Dr. Paul Carruthers is cheated by his employers after developing a new aftershave lotion, so he seeks revenge by using a giant killer bat to kill anyone wearing the lotion.

programme.title: Alle ved det
programme.desc: Oscar-vinderne Penélope Cruz og Javier Bardem spiller hovedrollerne i dobbelt-Oscar-vinder Asghar Farhadis intense drama, der udspiller sig i en idyllisk landsby lidt uden for Madrid. Her samles familiemedlemmer fra nær og fjern til stor fest.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Brutal Abduction
programme.desc: A Chicago street gang thought they had figured out how to kidnap people for ransom again and again, and never get caught. But their one mistake was they underestimated the Federal Bureau of Investigation.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Radical Agenda
programme.desc: In the 1970's a string of bank robberies and bombings spread fear and destruction along the east coast. The FBI faced a new breed of criminal, the domestic terrorist.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Killing Zone
programme.desc: In the 1990's the war on drugs was in full swing. The front lines were often America's inner cities where gangs use violence and murder to rule their empires.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Takeover
programme.desc: Two armed bank robbers hit a Seattle bank taking over 150,000 dollars. Before they can escape police confront them and the pair splits up. As authorities search block by block they learn one was a career criminal with a long history of violence.

programme.title: Watching the Detectives
programme.desc: Neil er en rigtig filmnørd, som ejer en lille videobutik. Når han ikke sidder fastklistret foran fjernsynet og en eller anden film noir, diskuterer han film med sine to medarbejdere, supernørden Lucien og den noget stabilere Jonathan.

programme.title: Meet the Spartans
programme.desc: Det store slag har sin begyndelse da helten Leonidas – kun bevæbnet med læderundertøj og en kappe – førersin gruppe af 13(!) krigere mod nord for at forsvare hjemlandet mod…

programme.title: Taken 2
programme.desc: Den tidligere CIA agent, Bryan Mills, reddede for et år siden sin datter fra en brutal trafficking-mafia. Men intet er glemt og intet er tilgivet, for nu vil faderen til et af Bryans ofre have hævn.

programme.title: American Siege
programme.desc: Den afdankede sherif i en lille by i Georgia, Ben Watts, bliver presset til hurtigt at løse en gidselsituation – og indser snart, at han er en brik i et større spil blandt byens skumle hemmeligheder.

programme.title: Fortress: Sniper's Eye
programme.desc: Den pensionerede CIA-agent Robert kaster sig ud i en vovemodig redningsaktion af sin ærkefjendes enke, Sasha. Men snart konfronteres Robert med et velkendt ansigt, som han troede, han aldrig skulle se igen...

programme.title: Exit Through the Giftshop
programme.desc: Banksys dokumentarfilm om street art, der udforsker en franskmands forsøg på at lave en film om Banksy.

programme.title: This Property Is Condemned
programme.desc: Robert Redford and Natalie Wood headline this sexually charged Depression-era drama. Redford plays Owen Legate, a railroad official come to backwater with pink slips for the yard employees.

programme.title: Andromeda: For Whom the Bell Tolls
programme.desc: Andromeda bliver hjemsøgt af et mystisk væsen, der kommer om bord under en solstorm.

programme.title: Mutant X: Tagelsen af krager
programme.desc: Da Lexa uden at vide det bliver bedøvet med et dødeligt stof, må holdet løbe om kap for at finde modgiften, før det er for sent.

programme.title: Mutant X: Mørkets skygger
programme.desc: Mutant X-holdet bliver tilkaldt for at undersøge bizarre aktiviteter, der finder sted på et lokalt hospital.

programme.title: Mutant X: Guds hånd
programme.desc: Mutant X-holdet begiver sig ud på en mission for at finde og fange en magtfuld supermutant, der har gudelignende kræfter.

programme.title: Mutant X: Ødemark
programme.desc: Jesse tvinges til at genoptage forbindelsen med sin tidligere forlovede, da Mutant X-holdet finder ud af, at hendes firma er involveret i genetisk manipulation af afgrøder.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The C-11 Squad
programme.desc: New York City is not stranger to gang violence. But when a 12-year-old child was kidnapped, the gangs had crossed a line. Law enforcement raced to find the missing boy before it was too late.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Moving Target
programme.desc: When a sniper in Utah started targeting African-American men for death, authorities launched a massive investigation. With scant clues and no witnesses they found the odds stacked against them, and they had no idea where the killer would strike next.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Unlawful Flight
programme.desc: In Alabama, two desperate criminals fled the custody of a local deputy. Eluding authorities, they made their way across the country in a wave of car theft, abduction, and murder.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Millionaire Murder
programme.desc: A businessman went to Florida to make one last deal before he retired-he never returned home to his millions. Authorities examined who was closest to him and who stood to gain from his disappearance. But this time conventional rules didn't apply.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Short Fuse
programme.desc: Explosives Investigations: The crime lab is the place where science meets murder. In New York State, Eleanor Fowler opened a small package, which was mailed to her home. When she lifted the lid, the box exploded, killing her instantly.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Death Grip
programme.desc: Fingerprinting: The Identification Division of the FBI relies on fingerprints as one of the most effective ways to identify criminals.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Signed In Blood
programme.desc: Handwriting Analysis: We've all heard that our handwriting tells more about our personalities than we think. Are we risk-takers, have low-esteem, fun loving, or are we capable of murder?

programme.title: The New Detectives: Witness To Terror
programme.desc: Black Boxes: Little evidence is left after an airplane takes a deadly plunge from the sky. Investigators' best hope for an answer comes from the flight data recorder known as a black box.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Dust

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Back There

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Whole Truth

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Invaders

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Penny For Your Thoughts

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Twenty-Two

programme.title: The Haunting of...: Carole Radziwill
programme.desc: Author, journalist and Real Housewife Carole Radziwill returns to the Hamptons, New York beach home where she once encountered a ghostly presence.

programme.title: Pluto TV Hus fra helvede Promo
programme.desc: Kom indenfor, hvis du tør. Om dagen besøger vi ekstreme samlere og spøgelsesjagere, mens vi om aften skruer op for uhyggen med gyserfilm og træder indenfor i de mest rædselsvækkende, hjemsøgte huse. Filmene starter hver dag kl. 22.

programme.title: The Haunting of...: Kesha
programme.desc: World famous singer-songwriter, Kesha revisits the Texas bed and breakfast where she encountered a paranormal apparition so tortured and disturbed it haunts her to this day.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Razor Ruddock's Home
programme.desc: We visit the home of Soccer legend Neil "Razor" Ruddock which seems to be haunted. Is it his home specifically? Or are these ghosts attached to him?

programme.title: Past Hunters: Blackpool Pleasure Beach
programme.desc: Blackpool Pleasure Beach is one of the most visited attractions in the United Kingdom. People visit it not only for the fun, but to also hopefully catch a glimpse of the many ghosts that haunt there.

programme.title: Pluto TV Hus fra helvede Promo
programme.desc: Kom indenfor, hvis du tør. Om dagen besøger vi ekstreme samlere og spøgelsesjagere, mens vi om aften skruer op for uhyggen med gyserfilm og træder indenfor i de mest rædselsvækkende, hjemsøgte huse. Filmene starter hver dag kl. 22.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Whitby Hall
programme.desc: Built in the early 1800s, Whitby Hall used to be an administrative center and now stands as a public park and arts center. It has never before been investigated, but staff have reported many noises and presences among them.

programme.title: The Ghoul
programme.desc: A fanatical Egyptologist purchases a stolen jewel, believing in its power to restore the dead. The stone is pursued by a zealot determined to return it to the tomb from which it was stolen before it can release its worst power.

programme.title: The Raven (1963)
programme.desc: The sorcerer Craven learns from fellow magician Dr. Bedlo that his supposedly dead wife is alive and living at the castle of master sorcerer Dr. Scarabus. The film is presented without local subtitles.

programme.title: Troll
programme.desc: When an evil troll named Torok attempts to bring about cataclysmic changes that will forever erase mankind, an ancient sorceress and a young boy join forces to stop him before he can carry out his diabolical plan.

programme.title: Stranger Than Fiction
programme.desc: En revisor fra skattevæsenet bliver pludselig genstand for en fortælling, som kun han selv kan høre: en fortælling, der begynder at påvirke hele hans liv, fra hans arbejde til hans kærlighed til hans død.

programme.title: Birdman
programme.desc: For at bevise sit værd risikerer en tidligere filmhelt alt. I sin kamp mod forskelige kritikere, et alter ego, sin datter og en skuespiller stræber han efter at komme ud af middelmådigheden.

programme.title: Demain tout commence
programme.desc: Samuel nyder et sorgløst liv på Den Franske Riviera, indtil Kristin, som han har haft en kortvarig affære med, meddeler, at han er far til et nyfødt barn, overlader en lille pige til ham og stikker af!

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Perfect Heist
programme.desc: Bank robbery is a brazen yet simple crime. A mask, a gun, a note passed to a teller. But bank burglary is different. It takes skill to disable an alarm, to penetrate a locked vault.

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Stranger in Town
programme.desc: She appeared on the highway in the spring, a young woman, her life cut short, her past and her identity a mystery. Only by finding out who she was could we ever hope to find her killer.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hunter's Game
programme.desc: In the 1970s and 80s, people went to Alaska looking for a fresh start, to reinvent themselves, or to disappear for a while. Some of those disappearances weren't by choice.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Dixie Mafia
programme.desc: On Mississippi's Gulf Coast, a Judge and his politician wife are murdered in their home. The killer left few clues. It looked like a professional hit, and the investigation led nowhere. But the FBI refused to give up.

programme.title: Med Røven I Vandskorpen
programme.desc: Bill Murray spiller hovedrollen som Tripper Harrison, lejrchefen på Camp North Star. Der er masser af sjov og ballade i vente, mens han sammen med lejrens øvrige ledere gør, hvad han kan for at bryde alle regler.

programme.title: Humpday
programme.desc: Det har gået ti år siden Ben og Andrew var skolens 'bad boys' i college. Ben er faldet til ro og har skaffet sig arbejde, kone og villa. Andrew har valgt at gå en anden vej som kringvandrende kunstner. Når Andrew uventet dukker op hos Ben ...

programme.title: Tommy Boy
programme.desc: Tommy har fået sit diplom og et job hos Callahan Auto Parts. Men familieforetagendet begynder at gå nedad bakke, og Tommy kører af sted med sin fars højre hånd, en dumsmart talknuser.

programme.title: Behaving Badly
programme.desc: Rick Stevens er villig til at gøre alt for at vinde Nina Penningtons hjerte. Selv hvis det betyder at indgå et væddemål med en gangster søn.

programme.title: Farvel til mafiaen
programme.desc: En mafia boss og hans familie er flyttet til en søvnig by i Frankrig, som en del af vidne beskyttelsesprogrammet, efter de vidnede mod mafiaen.

programme.title: Jeg hedder stadig Trinity
programme.desc: Verdens populæreste spaghettihelte, Terence Hill og Bud Spencer er denne gang meget mod deres vilje kommet til at optræde som tapre mænd.

programme.title: Cool World
programme.desc: Mens Jack Deebs sad i fængsel, fandt han en måde at slippe derfra ved at skabe Cool World, en tegneserie med en smuk kvinde ved navn Holli Would. Kødet viser sig dog at være svagere end blæk, da Holli tager menneskeform i Las Vegas.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Sydney's løn
programme.desc: Quan Shu, Manchuriet 1359 f.Kr.: Kineserne opfinder et eksplosivt gaveæg. New York, 2001: En rival slår Sydney og Nigel med et kort, der fører til drageægget.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Vampyrens kys
programme.desc: Lucas Blackmer, en babe-magnet, professor og forfatter, beder Sydney om at hjælpe med at finde Vlad Tepes' forsvundne relikvie. Og han er ikke den eneste, der er ude efter den.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Hr Rigtig
programme.desc: Sydney støder på sin eks Gray og tager på ferie med ham til Bali, men da Derek Lloyd dukker op og beder hende om at finde Parvatis skål, kan hun ikke lade være.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Sydney klokken ti
programme.desc: Sydneys værelseskammerat fra skolen er på sporet af et vedhæng fra sin fortid og beder Sydney om at hjælpe med at finde det og fange morderen.

programme.title: Andromeda: And Your Heart Will Fly Away
programme.desc: Da en længe savnet kærlighed vender tilbage, forsvinder Tyr fra skibet for at beskytte hende mod en lejemorder.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Global Pursuit
programme.desc: In Langley, Virginia, a terrorist fired into rush hour traffic. The victims seemed randomly selected, but the motive appeared to be political, targeting employees of the Central Intelligence Agency.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the 1980s the drug trade ravaged Chicago's inner city neighborhoods. Heroin and cocaine sales soared. Violent crime threatened to destroy the community.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: They were a gang of criminal masterminds. They carried automatic weapons and were not afraid to use them. With each and every new heist, they became bolder and more deadly, until the FBI stepped in, determined to end their violent rampage.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Surveillance video is often the most precise witness to a crime. After three brutal murders were caught on tape in Alabama, the suspects fled the area. They had an arsenal of stolen weapons, and swore they wouldn't be taken alive.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Trial Of The Century
programme.desc: Forensics in the O.J. Simpson Murder Trial: Millions watched on television as the jury rendered their verdict. Orenthal James Simpson was found not guilty of murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly Target
programme.desc: Ballistics: A corpse is found with a gunshot wound to the head; the weapon lies next to the victim. It looks like suicide, but could it be murder? It's a question best solved by ballistics experts.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fatal Compulsion
programme.desc: Forensic psychologists delve into the minds of serial killers, explaining why, most often, they can be a friendly neighbor or the tenacious co-worker: the one who hides his or her dark side better than anyone else.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Bodies of Evidence
programme.desc: It is difficult to convict a murderer if the body can't be found. But forensic science is finding ways to do it. Devious killers can think up many was to dispose of their victim's remains, but they are often no matches for investigators.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Carnfield Hall
programme.desc: Carnfield Hall is a country house dating from the 15th and 16th Centuries. This private residence turn event hall is using its paranormal activity to draw in business. Are these spirits the old residents?

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: A longtime grudge between two families linked by a brutal mob revenge killing persists in the historic Scott County Jail, whose current caretakers have transformed it into a paranormal research center.

programme.title: Pluto TV Hus fra helvede Promo
programme.desc: Kom indenfor, hvis du tør. Om dagen besøger vi ekstreme samlere og spøgelsesjagere, mens vi om aften skruer op for uhyggen med gyserfilm og træder indenfor i de mest rædselsvækkende, hjemsøgte huse. Filmene starter hver dag kl. 22.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: Brandon, Mustafa, Malia, and Kevin engage in a roundtable discussion highlighting their most shocking finds and new data that they’ve gathered across their numerous investigations.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: Benham, Kentucky’s idyllic, small-town aesthetic belies its dark and bloody past, rife with greed and conflict. There are many who believe the community is living under the shadow of a mountain that bore witness to an evil supernatural occurrence.

programme.title: White Zombie
programme.desc: A plantation owner desires another man's bride and enlists the help of a witch doctor to use a mind-control potion to make her fall in love with him. Instead, the witch doctor turns against them both.

programme.title: Dark Star
programme.desc: Vi er i midten af det 21. århundarede, og mennesket har udforsket hele solsystemet. Kolonister har forladt Jorden for at finde nye hjem i universet. Det bevæbnede rumskib "Dark Star" skal bane vej for alle disse fredelige kolonister.

programme.title: The Little Shop Of Horrors
programme.desc: En butiksassistent støder på en mystisk plante med sult efter blod. Succes følger, men prisen viser sig at være menneskeliv, og situationen eskalerer.

programme.title: Certified Copy
programme.desc: En kvinde og en forfatter udforsker identitet og kærlighed i Toscana. Romantik med Juliette Binoche.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Shattered Shield
programme.desc: In a city awash in narcotics the drug lords have all the power even over the police. Corruption in New Orleans grew like cancer, eating away at public safety and threatening to destroy the city. Crooked cops break the laws they were sworn to uphold.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hidden Agenda
programme.desc: Across the Midwest, a band of armed robbers struck banks at the rate of nearly one per month. They attacked with lightning precision and lethal force. They were in and out in five minutes.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber
programme.desc: For nearly two decades a mathematical genius with delusions of single-handedly destroying industrial society, planted or mailed powerful bombs to unsuspecting innocent victims.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy
programme.desc: The sun set on the Wild West long ago, but some people refused to notice. Claude Dallas was one of them. A wily trapper, Dallas typified the rugged individualism that forged this country. He went too far when he killed two game wardens in 1981.

programme.title: Election
programme.desc: Reese Witherspoon spiller Tracy Flick, en handlekraftig elev, der vil være elevrådsformand på Carver High. Den populære lærer Jim McAllister (Broderick) vil afspore Tracys besatte overpræstation ved at rekruttere en oppositionskandidat.

programme.title: Swingers: Swingers
programme.desc: I denne morsomme indie-komedieklassiker, der startede karrieren for et enestående sæt skuespillere, sætter to venner sig for at omdanne moderne dating fra Los Angeles til Las Vegas.

programme.title: 24 Hours to Live
programme.desc: Travis Conrad, som er tidligere elitesoldat, er tynget af sorg over tabet af sin hustru og sin lille søn, da en tidligere soldaterkammerat, Jim Morrow, dukker op med et farligt og lukrativt jobtilbud.

programme.title: Setup
programme.desc: De tre venner Vincent, Sonny og Dave planlægger et stort diamantkup. Men Vincent har brug for alle pengene selv og skyder de to andre. Dog overlever Sonny og vil have hævn.

programme.title: Hjælp, jeg ser rødt
programme.desc: Morskaben begynder i Miami, da politiaspiranten Dave Speed spillet af den hysterisk morsomme Terence Hill, sendes ud til et øde sumpområde for at aflevere en bøde. Da han kommer derud, udsættes han ved et uheld for et radioaktivt stof...

programme.title: The Last Redemption
programme.desc: I et rige fyldt med magi og svig kæmper den frygtløse lovløse Diana mod den ondskabsfulde Lord Roland. Sammen med sine brødre og den unge ridder Tyrion begiver hun sig ud på et farligt eventyr for at redde prinsessen og riget.

programme.title: Andromeda: Den uovervindelige mand
programme.desc: Spiller i et alternativt univers, hvor Dylan er død, og Gaheris Rhade forsøger at reformere Commonwealth.

programme.title: Andromeda: Delenda Est
programme.desc: Den gruppe, der angreb Andromeda under den første underskrivelse af Commonwealth-charter, vender tilbage for at skabe mere ravage.

programme.title: Andromeda: Det mørke bagud
programme.desc: Trance gennemgår nogle forskellige scenarier og forsøger at finde et, hvor hendes besætningsmedlemmer ikke dør.

programme.title: Mutant X: Ingen udgang
programme.desc: En mutant, der har evnen til at interfasere med enhver computer med sit sind, og som er lammet efter et møde med holdet, overtager Sanctuary's computere.

programme.title: Mutant X: Broders Vogter
programme.desc: Mutant X-holdet får kendskab til Lexas fremmedgjorte tvillingebror, da han bliver hovedmålet for en underjordisk operation, der høster mutantorganer.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the late 1980s the FBI matched wits with a cunning bank robber, a lone gunman responsible for the longest string of unsolved bank robberies in FBI history.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Predator
programme.desc: In the early 1990's, Washington, D.C., became the murder capital of the nation. Few were left untouched by gang violence, which was ignited by the drug trade. By 1994, that violence would strike at the very heart of law enforcement.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In Puerto Rico, a band of extremists waged a guerrilla war against the United States. Their goal, to make the island an independent nation, or die trying.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Dishonored
programme.desc: Shirley Russell was determined enough to reach the rank of Captain in the United States Marine Corps. When this officer turned up missing, her colleagues refused to believe she had gone AWOL. It was unclear whether Captain Shirley Russell was alive.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Shreds of Evidence
programme.desc: Hairs and Fibers: The tiniest filament can become a mark of distinction in the most singular and intimate of ways. Investigators have come to rely on forensic evidence as fine as a carpet fiber or as innocent as an eyelash to crack difficult cases.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Seeds of Destruction
programme.desc: Forensic Botany & Geology: Plants help provide oxygen and nutrients for existence. Soil is the fertilizer of life. Yet both can yield clues to the time and location of a person's death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Lethal Dosage
programme.desc: Toxicology: While drugs can cure disease and ease pain, they can also be agents of murder. Toxicologists can examine blood and tissue to uncover cases where death is not as natural as it may seemfrom slow arsenic poisoning to quick cocaine overdoses.

programme.desc: Micki is sent through a two-way time portal contained within a painting and finds herself at the mercy of the Marquis de Sade.

programme.title: Friday the 13th: The Series: Jack In The Box
programme.desc: A friend of Micki's, who works at a pool club, is drowned by two intruders. The widow inadvertently gives her daughter a jack-in-the-box from a sailor's museum.

programme.title: Friday the 13th: The Series: Night Hunger
programme.desc: A young hot rodder is given a gift by Lewis Vendredi: a silver key chain that lets him win car races. However, he must kill those he races against to get the curse to work.

programme.title: Friday the 13th - The TV series
programme.desc: En spenningsserie som handler om det overnaturlige. I hver episode begir fire modige sjeler seg ut på et oppdrag i fare og redsel når de sporer opp og henter tilbake forbannede gjenstander. Mysteriet starter fra kl. 20 hver kveld.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: The team journeys to Bardstown, KY which is hailed as “the oldest Western stagecoach stop in America” and a prominent location for the state’s famed bourbon trail and home to the infamous Talbott Tavern.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: The team meets with author David Domine to learn about the tragedy of Annie Whipple, a supposed “witch” who communicated with spirits to save the life of a child in her care.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: Brandon investigates the Conrad-Caldwell House, a Victorian-era home that’s said to still be inhabited by some of its original owners.

programme.title: The Island of Dr. Moreau
programme.desc: In this classic adaptation of H.G. Wells' novel, a demented doctor (Burt Lancaster) spends years on a desolate tropical island working on a drug that will effectively alter animals into humans. Michael York and Barbara Carrera also star!

programme.title: The Ape
programme.desc: A mad scientist trying to cure polio must obtain human spinal fluid, and resorts to nefarious means by wearing an ape suit to procure victims for his experiment without being detected.

programme.title: The Ghoul
programme.desc: A fanatical Egyptologist purchases a stolen jewel, believing in its power to restore the dead. The stone is pursued by a zealot determined to return it to the tomb from which it was stolen before it can release its worst power.

programme.title: Destroyer
programme.desc: Som ung offiser gikk LADP-etterforsker Erin Bell (Nicole Kidman) undercover og innfiltrerte en gjeng i ørkenen, et oppdrag med tragisk utfall. Nå, mange år senere, dukker bandens leder opp på ny, og Erin tvinges til å se fortidens demoner i øynene.

programme.title: Clueless
programme.desc: Chers verden rakner når to lekre menn plutselig dukker opp: en sexy, ny klassekamerat og den søte eks-stebroren hennes. Nå oppdager hun at når det kommer til kjærlighet, er hun totalt uvitende.

programme.title: The 51st State
programme.desc: Intet kunne forberede den tøffe undergrunnen i Liverpool på den kiltkledte-designerdrug-handlende Elmo McElroy, som har brent mer enn broer bak seg i L.A.

programme.title: Aeon Flux
programme.desc: Oscar-vinner* Charlize Theron har hovedrollen som Aeon Flux, undergrunnsagenten som kjemper mot et totalitært regime i jordens siste by i det 25. århundre.

programme.title: Snowden
programme.desc: Manuset er basert på bøkene The Snowden Files: The Inside Story of the World's Most Wanted Man av Luke Harding og Time of the Octopus av Anatoly Kucherena.

programme.title: What Happens In Vegas
programme.desc: Etter en ekstremt fuktig kveld på byen våkner to svært forskjellige fremmede opp på et hotellrom. Jack og Joy har begge fått en ektefelle og masse penger de ikke hadde dagen før! Med Ashton Kutcher og Cameron Diaz.

programme.title: Magic in the Moonlight
programme.desc: Magikeren Stanley Crawford (Colin Firth) er skeptisk til alt som kan karakteriseres som "overnaturlig", men når han møter den forførende spåkvinnen Sophie Baker (Emma Stone), oppdager han en verden hinsides fysikkens lover.

programme.title: The Ice Road
programme.desc: Etter at en fjerntliggende diamantgruve kollapser i Nord-Canada tar Mike oppdraget med å lede redningsoperasjonen, og må trosse de brutale naturkreftene i Canadas villmark.

programme.title: Taken 3
programme.desc: Eks-agenten Bryan Mills er forsont med sin tidligere kone, men lykken blir kortvarig når hun brutalt myrdes og han blir beskyldt for udåden.

programme.title: Pumping Iron
programme.desc: Arnold Schwarzenegger og Lou Ferrigno møter hverandre i en intens konkurranse om Mr. Olympia-tittelen i denne kritikerroste filmen som gjorde Schwarzenegger berømt.

programme.title: When Worlds Collide
programme.desc: An impending collision with a runaway star signals the destruction of earth. As doomsday approaches, they race against time and the panic of those who will be left behind.

programme.title: Andromeda: Mad to Be Saved
programme.desc: Mannskapet redder en gruppe flyktninger, bare for å oppdage at de har vært utsatt for regjeringseksperimenter og er ekstremt ustabile.

programme.title: Andromeda: Cui Bono
programme.desc: Bekas onkel løper for kontoret i New Commonwealth, men et attentat får mannskapet til å opptre som hans sikkerhet.

programme.title: Mutant X: Into the Moonless Night
programme.desc: I den spennende sesongåpningen kommer de overlevende medlemmene av Mutant X ut av en dødelig eksplosjon for å møte Lexa, som får dem til å begynne å stille spørsmål ved grunnleggende antagelser om deres verden.

programme.title: Mutant X: Wages of Sin
programme.desc: Mutant X-teamet må stoppe auksjonen av et sterkt dødelig stoff som flere beryktede internasjonale terrorister kjemper om å skaffe seg.

programme.title: Mutant X: The Breed
programme.desc: Mutant X-teamet blir hentet inn for å hjelpe en militærbase som har blitt smittet med en dødelig sykdom.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killer Abroad
programme.desc: Beginning in 1990, Europe found itself in the clutches of a serial killer. He became an international outlaw, hopping from country to country to evade capture and to kill again.

programme.title: The FBI Files: .22 Caliber Killer
programme.desc: In Buffalo, New York, a sniper targeted African-American men. He held a city hostage, and threatened to ignite a racial powder keg. And it looked like others might be following his bloody example.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber
programme.desc: For nearly two decades a mathematical genius with delusions of single-handedly destroying industrial society, planted or mailed powerful bombs to unsuspecting innocent victims.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Held For Ransom
programme.desc: Wealth has its rewards, but it also brings its dangers. Kidnapping is one of them. No ordeal is more horrifying for a family than to have a child taken.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Dead Men Do Talk
programme.desc: Profiles the work of world-renowned forensic experts and the procedures they use to solve murders and other mysteries in minutes or centuries after they happen.

programme.title: The New Detectives: In The Line of Fire
programme.desc: Bombers, snipers, spree killers: some people don't care who they kill, they just want to hurt innocent people.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Marked For Death
programme.desc: Sometimes killers are careful to leave no fingerprints behind. But methods of the murder itself can leave a lasting impression on police, especially when the tools (or weapons) of a killer's trade leave an innocent victim marked for death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Bloodlust
programme.desc: For homicide investigators, it's a race against time as they track their deadliest foe: a serial killer for whom killing is the only way to feel alive.

programme.title: Pluto TV Hus fra helvete Promo
programme.desc: Bli med inn hvis du tør. På dagtid besøker vi ekstremsamlere og spøkelsesjegere, mens vi om natten skrur opp stemningen med skrekkfilmer og går inn i de mest skremmende hjemsøkte husene.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Mindy Cohn, Valerie Harper, Matthew Gray-Gubler, Nicole Eggert
programme.desc: Looking for the perfect sanctuary to finish her book, Mindy Cohn is confronted with anything but solitude at a famous Pasadena apartment building; while at a crossroads.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Jerry Stiller, Mindy McCready, Nick Hogan, Lourdes Benedicto
programme.desc: Jerry Stiller receives a long awaited message from his father; a maternal figure appears to Mindy McCready at one of the darkest moments of her life.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Bret Michaels, Natasha Henstridge, Penelope Ann Miller, Eva Amurri
programme.desc: Faced with a decision that would change his life, Bret Michaels is visited by a close relative who points him toward his destiny.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Regis Philbin, Harry Hamlin, Ana Gasteyer, Jaime King
programme.desc: Regis Philbin spends a terrifying night in a notorious haunted house trying to coax its ghosts into sight; Harry Hamlin's wedding proposal is foiled by a ghost with a broken heart.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Hack Green Secret Nuclear Bunker
programme.desc: The Hack Green Secret Nuclear Bunker is a former government-owned nuclear bunker located at Hack Green, Cheshire, England. It Started as a decoy site for enemy bombers but later developed into a legitimate base. Now it is ripe with hauntings.

programme.title: The Raven (1963)
programme.desc: The sorcerer Craven learns from fellow magician Dr. Bedlo that his supposedly dead wife is alive and living at the castle of master sorcerer Dr. Scarabus. The film is presented without local subtitles.

programme.title: Dark Star NO
programme.desc: Det er midten av 2000-tallet, og mennesket har utforsket hele solsystemet. Kolonister har forlatt jorden for å finne nye hjem i universet. Det væpnede romskipet "Dark Star" skal bane vei for alle de fredelige kolonistene.

programme.title: On the road
programme.desc: Dean og Sal legger ut på “livets landevei” for å finne svar på livets mysterier og litt til. Det viser seg å bli en langt mer strabasiøs ferd en de hadde tenkt seg.

programme.title: Anchorman: The Legend of Ron Burgundy
programme.desc: Ron Burgundy er et superpopulært nyhetsanker i 1970-årenes San Diego som mener at kvinner kan pynte opp et nyhetsrom. Så når Ron får vite han skal jobbe med en smart, vakker ung dame som mestrer mer enn å være til pynt, blir det krig!

programme.title: Rough Stuff
programme.desc: En gruppe aktivister vil lage en film for å avdekke overtramp hos et stort gruveselskap, og de inngår en avtale med noen folk som lever utenfor loven, i Australias ødemark. Spenningen stiger når det viser seg at begge gruppene er på hver sin skattejakt.

programme.title: A Civil Action
programme.desc: Jan er personskadeadvokat, men tar bare store saker der han kan inngå forlik utenfor rettssalen. Selv om hans nye sak først ser enkel ut, blir han snart innblandet i en episk kamp, som han er villig til å satse karrieren sin på.

programme.title: Frankie & Johnny
programme.desc: Pfeiffer spiller Frankie, en servitrise som jobber på en kaffebar i New York. Etter en rekke vonde forhold er en ny mann det siste Frankie ser etter... helt til en kommer og ser etter henne.

programme.title: Big Momma's House
programme.desc: En FBI-agent kler seg som en eldre dame for å beskytte en kvinne.

programme.title: Fortress: Sniper's Eye
programme.desc: Den pensjonerte CIA-agenten Robert legger ut på en dristig redningsaksjon av erkefiendens enke, Sasha. Men snart blir Robert konfrontert med et kjent ansikt han trodde han aldri ville se igjen...

programme.title: Till Death
programme.desc: Etter en romantisk kveld i deres avsidesliggende hus, våkner Emma opp lenket til sin døde ektemann. Hun er fanget og isolert og må kjempe mot leiemordere for å unnslippe ektemannens avsindige plan.

programme.title: Meatballs
programme.desc: Bill Murray spiller Tripper Harrison, sjefsveileder på Camp North Star. Det blir underholdende når han, og den skandaløse gjengen hans av leirveiledere, har det for seg å bryte alle regler i boka.

programme.title: Welcome to Collinwood
programme.desc: Cosimo får en plan for en kjempejobb av sin cellekamerat. Han ber kvinnen sin om å finne en patsy for tyveriet av bilen hans, og tilbyr 15 000 dollar. Plutselig er 7 involvert.

programme.title: Mutant X: Where Evil Dwell
programme.desc: Mutant X-teamet må stoppe en seriemorder som etterlater ledetråder til sine neste ofre i form av gåter.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Wages of Sydney
programme.desc: Quan Shu, Manchuria 1359 f.Kr.: Kineserne oppfinner et eksplosivt gaveegg. New York, 2001: En rival slår Sydney og Nigel til et kart som fører til Dragon's Egg.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Vampire's Kiss
programme.desc: Lucas Blackmer, en babymagnet, professor og romanforfatter, ber Sydney hjelpe til med å finne Vlad Tepes 'tapte relikvie. Og han er ikke den eneste etter det.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Mr. Right
programme.desc: Sydney støter på eksen Gray og drar på ferie med ham til Bali, men når Derek Lloyd dukker opp for å verve henne til å finne Parvati's Bowl, kan hun ikke motstå.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Paradise
programme.desc: It should have been Shangri-La, but when bad blood developed, piracy took over and the only law was the law of the jungle.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cracking The Cartel
programme.desc: A mother and child are kidnapped a bystander is murdered. Violence such as this shattered a quiet Texas neighborhood and exposed a drug cartel that flourished where it was least expected.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Dead Run
programme.desc: In Pennsylvania, an inmate escaped with the help of his female accomplice. Following a trail of fraudulent credit card receipts and deaths, authorities track the pair, but always find themselves one step behind.

programme.title: The FBI Files: First and Kennedy Street Crew
programme.desc: In the early 1990's, Washington, D.C., became the murder capital of the nation. Few were left untouched by gang violence, which was ignited by the drug trade. By 1994, that violence would strike at the very heart of law enforcement.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Random Targets
programme.desc: Most victims of multiple murderers are meticulously chosen because of a mutual connection with the killer or because they match an intricate set of criteria that fits the killer's MO.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Trial By Fire
programme.desc: At a crime scene, anything left behind or seemingly out of place is considered a clue. But a fire can extinguish everything in its path challenging forensic investigators at every turn and making each arson a trial by fire.

programme.title: The New Detectives: True Crime
programme.desc: They know as much about crime as any crime fighter, or any criminal. They're the crime writers, and through their eyes we see murder most foul.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Trails of Evidence
programme.desc: In criminal investigations, a simple clue can provide the missing link by placing a suspect at a crime scene. Dirt left on shoes, tires or clothes, or even a tiny piece of plastic can pinpoint a crime scene.

programme.desc: The school closes and makes the best day / Butt-Head phones in a mail-order bride / Burger World launches a home delivery service

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Stewart is Missing / Yard Sale
programme.desc: Mrs. Stevenson shows up at Butt-head's house, desperate to enlist their help in finding Stewart. / Tom Anderson get Beavis and Butt-head to watch his yard sale, and the boys manage to sell everything when they take the sale inside.

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Tainted Meat / Bad Dog
programme.desc: Beavis and his bacteria ridden "thingy" contaminate the food at Burger World. / Beavis and Butt-head adopt a vicious dog at a shelter and it trains them.

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Crisis line / Career day
programme.desc: Beavis and Butt-Head set out to support callers on a crisis line / Later they go out on work experience as security guards

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: A Very Special Episode / Dumbasses Anonymous
programme.desc: Beavis and Butt-head come to the aid of a wounded baby bird...almost. / Beavis and Butt-head show up at an AA meeting hoping to score some booze.

programme.title: Mike Judge's Beavis & Butt-Head: Nektet service / Balleskvis
programme.desc: Beavis prøver yogabukser og får dem ikke av. / Guttene oppdager at de har rett til å nekte service til kunder på Burger World.

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: The Mystery of Morning Wood / U.S. History
programme.desc: Beavis and Butt-head try to stay awake all night, in an attempt to discover the secret behind morning wood. / For his oral report on an historical figure, Beavis recounts the valuable lessons he learned one night while eating at Burger World.

programme.title: Mike Judge's Beavis & Butt-Head: En spirituell reise
programme.desc: Beavis ser ansiktet til Jesus i en nacho-chips. Det sender ham på en episk reise for å finne svar på det store spørsmålet - "Hvorfor får jeg aldri pult?"

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Nose Bleed / Vaya Con Cornholio
programme.desc: Butt-head tries some sadistic home remedies in an attempt to stop Beavis's nosebleed. / When Beavis turns into Cornholio in Burger World, Immigration Officials take him in as a possible illegal alien and try to make sense of his gibberish.

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Give Blood / Beware of the Butt (aka Drive-In #1)
programme.desc: Beavis & Butt-head explore the career possibilities in selling blood. / While causing mischief at a drive-in movie theatre, Beavis & Butt-head experience a new phase of the moon.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Son of a Chechekevitch
programme.desc: The deputies vow to avenge Sheriff Chechekevitch's death, and Wiegel studies with Lamaze instructor Guy Gerricault.

programme.title: RENO 911!: The Investigation Continues
programme.desc: The investigation into Sheriff Chechekevitch's murder zeroes in on his ex-wife, and Williams and Wiegel attend a Lamaze class.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Corporate Sponsor
programme.desc: Hotty's Restaurants sponsors the Reno Sheriff's Department, and the gang gets burned by the deal.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Christian Karaoke Singles' Mixer
programme.desc: Clemmy scandalizes Kimball's Christian singles karaoke club, and Dangle takes bets on the origins of Wiegel's baby.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Execution Tickets
programme.desc: The deputies partake in a scavenger hunt to determine who gets to attend the execution of a convicted felon, and Williams gives a suspect a makeover.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Clementine's Pregnant
programme.desc: A mandatory staff drug test reveals a surprise pregnancy, and Lt. Dangle has a brush with a celebrity.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Jones Gets Suspended
programme.desc: Jones enjoys some unexpected perks after being relegated to crossing guard duty, and Dangle's bike is stolen again.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Help From the FBI
programme.desc: While the FBI investigates a Reno homicide, members of the Sheriff's Department put their best feet forward.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Wiegel Suicide Watch
programme.desc: The Reno Sheriff's Department lavishes attention on Wiegel after her failed suicide attempt, and Williams and Garcia hook up.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Once Upon a Time
programme.desc: Woodrow, a janitor living in the year 1890, accidentally activates a time traveling helmet which transports him to 1962 - then promptly breaks down.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Kick the Can
programme.desc: The senior residents of Sunnyvale decide that the secret to youth is acting young, and in particular playing a childhood game called "kick-the-can."

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Silence
programme.desc: Annoyed by a club member's constant chatter, a man bets him he cannot remain silent for a year, living in a glass enclosure in the club basement.

programme.title: The Stepford Wives
programme.desc: En kvinne flytter inn i et nabolag der en gruppe ektemenn har gjort konene sine til roboter som er designet for å ta vare på dem. Nyinnspilling av filmen fra 1975.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Nothing in the Dark
programme.desc: A lonely old woman refuses to leave her apartment for fear of meeting "Mr. Death."

programme.title: Pluto TV Hus fra helvete Promo
programme.desc: Bli med inn hvis du tør. På dagtid besøker vi ekstremsamlere og spøkelsesjegere, mens vi om natten skrur opp stemningen med skrekkfilmer og går inn i de mest skremmende hjemsøkte husene.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Mill Street Barracks
programme.desc: Built in 1861 Mill Street Barracks is steeped in rich history. It has accommodated many branches of the armed forces throughout its life. Like many other barracks it has also been used as a morgue making it a prime location for the supernatural.

programme.title: Past Hunters: The Block
programme.desc: The team investigate a disused factory in Burton-Upon-Trent. Reports of paranormal happenings are common and the team are ready for anything.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Plas Teg
programme.desc: The county of Flintshire in Wales is said to be a land filled with ghosts and haunts. Plas Teg is said to be one of the "most haunted" houses in the area. With over 400 years of history, this place is sure to be the home of many an entity.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: Kentucky is home to a slew of purportedly haunted locations, with some that are more notorious than others. By all local accounts, the Benton farmhouse should be considered one of the state’s most significant haunts.

programme.title: The Night Of The Hunter
programme.desc: Robert Mitchum stars in an unforgettable role as a psychopathic preacher in relentless pursuit of two children who have their dead father's stolen fortune hidden in a doll. Shelley Winters co-stars.

programme.title: The Little Shop Of Horrors
programme.desc: En butikkmedarbeider oppdager en mystisk plante med en blodtørstig appetitt. Suksess følger, men prisen viser seg å være menneskeliv, og situasjonen eskalerer.

programme.title: Troll
programme.desc: When an evil troll named Torok attempts to bring about cataclysmic changes that will forever erase mankind, an ancient sorceress and a young boy join forces to stop him before he can carry out his diabolical plan.

programme.title: Win A Date With Tad Hamilton!
programme.desc: Rosalee, en småbyjente fascinert av kjendiser, vinner en date med Hollywood-stjernen Tad Hamilton. For henne er det en drøm som går i oppfyllelse, men det betyr det totale kaos for hennes bestevenn Peter.

programme.title: Mean Girls
programme.desc: Etter å ha bodd i Afrika har Cady ingen anelse om hvor 'vilt' ting kan bli i sivilisasjonen før hun møter en av de slemmeste artene som finnes, 'Dronningbien', som på denne skolen er den kule og kalkulerende Regina George.

programme.title: The Arrival
programme.desc: Astronomen Zane oppdager intelligent utenomjordisk liv, men romvesenene holder på en dødelig hemmelighet og gjør hva som helst for å hindre Zane i å få vite den.

programme.title: Win A Date With Tad Hamilton!
programme.desc: Rosalee, en småbyjente fascinert av kjendiser, vinner en date med Hollywood-stjernen Tad Hamilton. For henne er det en drøm som går i oppfyllelse, men det betyr det totale kaos for hennes bestevenn Peter.

programme.title: Now Add Honey
programme.desc: Carolines liv er i fullstendig fritt fall. Døtrene hennes driver henne til vanvidd og den utakknemlige sjefen hennes kjører ut på henne mens mannen hennes forlater henne.

programme.title: Official Secrets
programme.desc: Den sanne historien om en britisk varsler som lekket informasjon til media om en ulovlig NSA-operasjon, hvis formål var å presse FNs sikkerhetsråd til å godkjenne invasjonen av Irak i 2003.

programme.title: Red Dawn
programme.desc: Når en amerikansk by blir invadert av nordkoreanske soldater, kommer en gruppe unge mennesker sammen for å beskytte hverandre, frigjøre byen og gjenvinne sin frihet.

programme.title: Taken
programme.desc: Den tidligere agenten Bryan Mills begynner de lengste 96 timene i sitt liv når han tar opp jakten på mennene som kidnappet datteren hans.

programme.title: The Lodger: A Story of the London Fog
programme.desc: En huseier mistenker at den nye losjeren hennes er galningen som dreper kvinner i London.

programme.title: Double Jeopardy
programme.desc: Libby Parsons, who discovers that the husband she’s convicted of murdering staged his own “death” and framed her for the crime. Released on parole, she skips town to find him–and that puts parole officer Travis Lehman on her trail.

programme.title: Murder!
programme.desc: En jurymedlem i en mordrettssak stemmer for å dømme, mens de andre jurymedlemmene har andre tanker og begynner å etterforske på egenhånd før henrettelsen.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Sydney at Ten
programme.desc: Sydneys samboer fra skolen er på sporet med et anheng fra fortiden hennes og verver Sydney for å hjelpe til med å finne den og fange morderen.

programme.title: Andromeda: Den ensomme og jevne sanden
programme.desc: Når Andromeda blir angrepet av rompirater, blir de reddet av et langt mistet romskip fra jorden.

programme.title: Andromeda: Slipfighter Hunder av Krig
programme.desc: Mannskapet oppdager at en falsk planet, Marduk, har skapt masseødeleggelsesvåpen.

programme.title: Andromeda: Lepras kyss
programme.desc: En hitman med navnet Leper er rettet mot lederne for det nye samveldet.

programme.title: Andromeda: For hvem bjelleveiene
programme.desc: Andromeda hjemsøkes av en mystisk skapning som kommer ombord under en solstorm.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Coffee Shop Murders
programme.desc: At a coffee shop in Washington, DC, three employees were shot to death. Evidence at the crime scene pointed in many different directions. Was this a hate crime, a robbery gone wrong or an act of cold-blooded vengeance?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Dishonored
programme.desc: Shirley Russell was determined enough to reach the rank of Captain in the United States Marine Corps. When this officer turned up missing, her colleagues refused to believe she had gone AWOL. It was unclear whether Captain Shirley Russell was alive.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Evil Intent
programme.desc: Drops of blood and a torn screen were all that's left to tell authorities what happened to a woman in Indiana. The 21 yr. old victim was taken from her home on a spring morning. She appeared to have no real enemies, there was no clear motive.

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Stranger in Town
programme.desc: She appeared on the highway in the spring, a young woman, her life cut short, her past and her identity a mystery. Only by finding out who she was could we ever hope to find her killer.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Material Witness
programme.desc: Lies and deceit can often throw investigators off the trail of justice. But when hard evidence contradicts a killer's story, police must use the clues to piece together the truth.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Unlikely Sources
programme.desc: Some of the best clues come from the least likely places. Baffling crimes have been solved and criminals betrayed through evidence provided by insects, beer bottles, and other seemingly meaningless objects.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Camera Clues
programme.desc: Forensic Photography: Forensic photographers are among the first people at a crime scene, capturing vital clues on film. What do the cameras capture that can't be seen first-hand, and who are the men and women who analyze the camera's clues?

programme.title: The New Detectives: Tainted Trust
programme.desc: Poison is the subtlest form of death, and investigators must see through unusual circumstances to bring these murders to light.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Kick the Can
programme.desc: The senior residents of Sunnyvale decide that the secret to youth is acting young, and in particular playing a childhood game called "kick-the-can."

programme.title: Scary Movie 2
programme.desc: Noen har ført kjærligheten din til oppfølgerne for langt! Favorittkomirollene til Scary Movie er tilbake i en film som skremmer opp enda mer ærbødig moro enn originalen med sitt syn på klisjéhjemsøkte thrillere.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Silence
programme.desc: Annoyed by a club member's constant chatter, a man bets him he cannot remain silent for a year, living in a glass enclosure in the club basement.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Dead Man's Shoes
programme.desc: A vagrant steps into a murdered gangster's expensive shoes and is taken over by the dead man's ghost, who vows to remain on Earth to seek revenge against his killer.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Ring-A-Ding Girl
programme.desc: Bunny receives a ring from her fan club in her home town. In the ring she sees the faces of people from her hometown telling her she's needed there so she returns home.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: A longtime fixture of the paranormal investigative landscape, Mackey’s has developed a reputation for being one of America’s creepiest haunts, supposedly hosting a dark energy that can leave some investigators mentally scarred.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: The oldest, and longest running movie theatre in Kentucky is now owned and operated by someone who never once thought about ghosts. However, a shocking experience with a woman dressed in white altered his belief in the supernatural forever.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: Augusta is home to Kentucky’s oldest jail, which housed prisoners since the early 1800s and still sits upon its original foundation today. While it now operates as a museum, there have been numerous guests who have claimed to see unexplainable things.

programme.title: The Haunting Of. . .: Bernie Kopell
programme.desc: Bernie Kopell ("Doc" on The Love Boat) goes back to the hotel in Niagra Falls, NY where he came eye to eye with a bloody ghost.

programme.title: The Haunting Of. . .: Kristen Renton
programme.desc: Kristen Renton (Sons of Anarchy / Days of Our Lives) went on a ghost hunt aboard the Queen Mary, a docked ship in Long Beach, CA.

programme.title: The Bat
programme.desc: A country mansion full of guests soon becomes the playground of a killer after a hidden stash of embezzled money. The guests begin to disappear one by one as The Bat's identity is closer to being discovered.

programme.title: Night Tide
programme.desc: Johnny, a sailor on leave from the Navy, sees Mora at a nightclub and is infatuated with her. As she warms up to him, he begins to suspect she is not human and soon discovers her secret.

programme.title: Election
programme.desc: Reese Witherspoon er Tracy Flick, en A-student som er bestemt på å bli president i elevrådet på Carver High. Læreren Jim McAllister (Broderick) bestemmer seg for å avspore Tracys tvangsmessige og ambisiøse oppførsel ved å rekruttere en motkandidat.

programme.title: Up In The Air
programme.desc: Ryan Bingham lever et høytsvevende liv. Han flyr over hele verden på forretningsreiser og er stadig på farten. Men så treffer han medpassasjeren Alex og lærer at livet ikke handler om reisen, men kontaktene man oppnår langs veien.

programme.title: Coach Carter
programme.desc: En inspirerende fortelling om basketballtrener Ken Carter, som fikk både ris og ros da han skapte overskrifter med å sette hele sitt ubeseirede lag på benken på grunn av dårlige akademiske prestasjoner.

programme.title: Monsters
programme.desc: I 2009 oppdaget NASA muligheten for fremmed liv innenfor vårt solsystem. En sonde ble skutt opp for å samle inn prøver fra en av Jupiters måner, Europa, men krasjet på tilbaketuren over Mellom-Amerika.

programme.title: Black Knight
programme.desc: Når en klok svart hustler fra South Central i Los Angeles finner seg transportert tilbake til middelalderens England, leder han styrtingen av en ond konge og vinner hjertet til en protofeministisk kvinne.

programme.title: Scary Movie 2
programme.desc: Noen har ført kjærligheten din til oppfølgerne for langt! Favorittkomirollene til Scary Movie er tilbake i en film som skremmer opp enda mer ærbødig moro enn originalen med sitt syn på klisjéhjemsøkte thrillere.

programme.title: The Disappearance of Eleanor Rigby: Them
programme.desc: Engang var Conor og Eleanor lykkelig gift. Nå føler de seg fremmed for hverandre, og i kjølevannet av en tragisk hendelse lengter de etter å finne tilbake til det liv og den kjærligheten de engang hadde.

programme.title: Sweet Carolina
programme.desc: Josie vender tilbake til den lille hjembyen sin da hun uventet blir verge for niesen og nevøen sin. Der møter hun Cooper, kjæresten fra high school.

programme.title: Hercules in New York
programme.desc: Bannlyst fra Olympus, blir Hercules (Arnold Schwarzenegger) sendt til Jorden, hvor han finner ekte kjærlighet og starter en lysende karriere som kroppsbygger.

programme.title: Wim Wenders Collection: Wings of Desire aka Der Himmel über Berlin
programme.desc: En høyt lovprist og prisbelønnet film, som blant annet fikk prisen for beste regi i Cannes i 1987. Damiel er en ensom engel som streifer omkring i Berlins krigsmerkede gater og trøster dødelige i nød.

programme.title: Mutant X: The Taking of Crows
programme.desc: Når Lexa uvitende er dopet med et dødelig stoff, må teamet løpe for å finne motgiften før det er for sent.

programme.title: Mutant X: Shadows of Darkness
programme.desc: Mutant X-teamet blir kalt inn for å undersøke bisarre aktiviteter som skjer på et lokalt sykehus.

programme.title: Mutant X: The Hand of God
programme.desc: Mutant X-teamet legger ut på oppdrag for å finne og fange en kraftig supermutant som har gudlignende krefter.

programme.title: Mutant X: Wasteland
programme.desc: Jesse blir tvunget til å komme i kontakt med sin tidligere forlovede når Mutant X-teamet får vite at selskapet hennes er involvert i genetisk manipulering av avlinger.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: The Light of Truth
programme.desc: Arabia 843 e.Kr.: En sjeik bruker sannhetens lys for å avsløre sin general som en forræder. 2001: Prince Shareem dropper fra Sydneys klasse for å søke etter sannhetens lys.

programme.title: The FBI Files: When Seconds Count
programme.desc: On July 2nd 1994, a 12-year-old girl was abducted from her home in northern California. The FBI knows to act fast, search wide, enlist volunteers. But as the hours slipped by, agents also realized their chances for recovering her alive grew slim.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Vanished
programme.desc: A daring kidnapping and a bizarre ransom note baffled Mississippi authorities. The victim was the wife of a wealthy businessman. A list of 12 names and a few drops of blood were the only clues to her fate.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Unlawful Flight
programme.desc: In Alabama, two desperate criminals fled the custody of a local deputy. Eluding authorities, they made their way across the country in a wave of car theft, abduction, and murder.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy
programme.desc: The sun set on the Wild West long ago, but some people refused to notice. Claude Dallas was one of them. A wily trapper, Dallas typified the rugged individualism that forged this country. He went too far when he killed two game wardens in 1981.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Family Plots
programme.desc: Every family has its secrets, and sometimes blood relations lead to bloodshed. When murder becomes a family affair, investigators must turn to forensics to uncover family plots.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Murderous Attraction
programme.desc: In Columbus, Ohio, a woman is found shot in the head. The death is ruled a suicide, but something is not right and detectives refuse to let the matter rest.

programme.title: The New Detectives: For Love Or Money
programme.desc: Every family has its secrets, and sometimes blood relations lead to bloodshed. When money is the motive, murder can rip at the very foundation of marriage and family.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Mind Hunters
programme.desc: Psychological Profiling: Journey into the dark recesses and calculated madness present only in our worst nightmares, and in the minds of serial killers.

programme.desc: Patricia is terrorized by a ghost who escapes from the pages of an antique book. Susie feels she has made the biggest mistake of her life but finds forgiveness and unconditional love from the spirit of her grandmother.

programme.desc: After moving into an old country house, Enrico has a series of horrifying encounters that make him realize he's not the only one residing in the home.

programme.title: My Haunted House: The Nursery and The Closet
programme.desc: A dangerous entity stalks a pregnant woman in her new house. A single mother discovers a terrifying secret trapped in her son's closet. The shocking eyewitness accounts of terrified people whose dream homes have become nightmares.

programme.title: Blacula
programme.desc: The eternally cool William Marshall puts a fresh spin on the age-old legend of the vampire, condemned to wander the Earth with an insatiable lust for blood in "Blacula," often credited as the first African-American horror film.

programme.title: The Night Of The Hunter
programme.desc: Robert Mitchum stars in an unforgettable role as a psychopathic preacher in relentless pursuit of two children who have their dead father's stolen fortune hidden in a doll. Shelley Winters co-stars.

programme.title: The Little Shop Of Horrors
programme.desc: En butiksanställd upptäcker en mystisk växt med en blodtörstig aptit. Framgång följer, men priset visar sig vara människoliv, och situationen eskalerar.

programme.title: Incendies
programme.desc: När notarien Lebel ska läsa upp Nawals testamente för hennes barn Jeanne och Simon, upptäcker de två kuvert: ett till den far de trodde var död, och ett till en bror som de inte visste om.

programme.title: Människojägaren
programme.desc: I Steve McQueens sista film får vi se den framlidne, store skådespelarens dynamiska talang i en av hans mest minnesvärda roller: den sanna historien om Ralph "Papa" Thorson, en moderna tiders prisjägare.

programme.title: Vanquish
programme.desc: Damon, ett pensionerat polisbefäl, kidnappar sin vårdare Victorias dotter. För att rädda sin dotter tvingas Victoria hjälpa Damon att lura hans korrupta kollegor i ett försök att rensa upp i stan innan det är för sent.

programme.title: Vault
programme.desc: Filmen utspelar sig 1975 och är inspirerad av den sanna historien om en grupp småbrottslingars försök att begå den största stöten i USA:s historia.

programme.title: Den fantastiske räven

programme.title: Jackass Presents: Bad Grandpa .5
programme.desc: varning: Den här filmen innehåller nytt material som är oklippt, skandalöst och mycket olämpligt! Bad Grandpa .5 ger dig ett helt nytt perspektiv på Irving Zismans värld, med otroliga bonusscener och kul skämt.

programme.title: Misbehaviour
programme.desc: År 1970 gjorde en grupp kvinnor upp en plan för att sabotera världens största skönhetstävling, Miss World - för att driva patriarkatet av scenen och vända det skeva skönhetsidealet upp och ner.

programme.title: The Ice Road
programme.desc: När en gruva kollapsar i Kanada fångas en grupp gruvarbetare. Nu måste Jim hitta långtradarförare som kan transportera räddningsutrustning via farliga isvägar över frusna vatten innan det är för sent.

programme.title: Mommie Dearest
